# Embedded Preset Reference

The release binary contains **4 named addon presets**. Presets select addons only; Plex and Jellyfin remain explicit project choices.

| Preset | Title | Addons | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `minimal` | Minimal seedbox | `filebrowser` | Just the essentials: qBittorrent behind a VPN, plus a web file browser to poke at downloads. No automation, no media server, no requests. The smallest sane stack. |
| `media-plex` | TV automation (Plex) | `sonarr`, `prowlarr`, `filebrowser` | Curated Plex TV automation with Sonarr, Prowlarr for indexers, and File Browser for direct file access. |
| `media-jellyfin` | TV automation (Jellyfin) | `sonarr`, `prowlarr`, `filebrowser` | Curated Jellyfin TV automation with Sonarr, Prowlarr for indexers, and File Browser for direct file access. |
| `power-user` | Power user | `sonarr`, `radarr`, `lidarr`, `bazarr`, `prowlarr`, `nzbhydra2`, `sabnzbd`, `filebrowser`, `recyclarr` | Broad movie, TV, music, subtitle and Usenet automation with direct file access and scheduled profile synchronization. Specialist libraries, invitation portals and transcoders stay opt-in. |

User presets in `~/.config/sdbx/presets.yaml` may override these names locally. The generated release reference intentionally ignores those machine-specific overlays.
